title: Das Geißenklösterle
creators: Universität Tübingen, Ältere Urgeschichte und Quartärökologie
bibliographicNote: Excavators’ site account consulted: cave in the Ach valley near Blaubeuren, Aurignacian finds, two bird-bone flutes and one ivory flute. Its bibliography also identifies the swan-bone flute. No preserved melody or particular social function is claimed.
